profile.headline: Software Engineer - Customer Portal at GE Aviation
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience using Java and Spring to create REST API’s and automating business processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Customer Portal
positions.description:
• Rewriting Technical Publications Spring Boot web services to improve download performance and eliminating defects in existing services
    • Migrated a Java Spring Boot micro-service that indexes technical documents to Amazon Elasticsearch to an AWS Lambda function to allow indexes to be updated as soon as a document is published to S3, rather than on a weekly scheduled basis
    • Developed an AWS Lambda, written in Java, to read Lucene Index files and store indexes in a PostgreSQL lookup table to improve link generation in HTML files for technical documents
    • Developed an AWS Lambda, written in Python3, to read SGML documents in AWS S3 and store category information in a Postgres database to be used later to determine if a user can create warranty claims for an engine or engine parts
    • Maintain code bases of Spring Boot micro-services and AWS Lambda functions through code reviews to ensure quality is maintained
    • Regularly communicate with product owners to ensure functionality meets business expectations
    • Provide guidance and cross functional training to team members for new tools and technologies

positions.title: Software Engineer Specialist - Customer Portal
positions.description: Develop and maintain RESTful microservices for a customer facing portal using Java 8, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL. Services allow customers to generate and view documents regarding engine part history.

projects.title: Campsite Reservation
projects.description: A menu driven console application that allows a user to reserve a campsite for a given amount of time.  User picks a park and a campground they want to stay at; they are then returned a list of camp sites and a dollar amount for the cost of the stay.  Once they pick a site, a reservation is made and a confirmation code is returned to the user.  All data is stored in a Microsoft SQL Server database.

projects.title: National Park Weather Web App
projects.description: ASP.NET MVC web app that displays a list of national parks from a SQL Server database.  Allows user to view more detail about a selected park.  The detail view of a park also shows data for the weather at that location.  The site allows the user to view the temperature as either fahrenheit or celsius.  Users can also participate in a survey asking about what their favorite parks are.
